master: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original premium background painting for Local Asset Studio's Atelier workspace skin. Scene: a warm artist's drafting room opening onto a serene small stone courtyard. On the RIGHT quarter is a beautiful modest walnut drafting desk with cream drawing paper, a brushed-metal task lamp glowing warm amber, a simple stool and a small linen roll. No computer screens or devices, no people. Beyond the right-side open doorway: quiet courtyard plants and softly illuminated stone, dusk approaching. The room feels tactile, intimate and creative, not luxury-office photography. Hand-painted architectural illustration with precise believable perspective, refined material texture, soft ambient occlusion and gently restrained edges. Palette walnut brown, warm ivory plaster, linen cream, small muted sage courtyard accents. COMPOSITION IS CRITICAL: ultra-clean middle-left 60 percent consists mostly of a softly illuminated, nearly empty warm plaster wall with subtle texture and no busy objects, shelf edges or plants behind prospective HTML text. Focal desk and warm lamp around normalized x=.78, y=.65, safely away from extreme edges. Fixed wide camera, eye-level slight three-quarter view. Landscape16:9, target3840x2160 if supported, with12% crop overscan around important objects. It should remain quiet and readable as a background behind a software workspace. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, interface, buttons, graphs, framed writing, decorative symbols, progress indicators or recognizable branded objects. This is one standalone finished scene, not a collage or mockup.
quiet: Edit this exact Atelier room into its quiet morning counterpart. Preserve the EXACT camera, composition, perspective, architecture, every object, window geometry, desk, lamp, stool, plant, pots, rug and canvas dimensions. Only change illumination and time of day: gentle diffuse pale morning daylight through the same courtyard opening, cooler ivory plaster, soft sage greenery, lamp switched off, subdued calm shadows instead of amber evening beams. Same room and same object placement, not a redesign. No added/removed objects, no new text, no people, no UI. Pixel registration and unchanged silhouettes are more important than dramatic lighting.
wall: Use this exact Atelier room as the visual place reference. Create a quieter 3:2 landscape panel-wall adaptation of the SAME warm ivory plaster and walnut room, not a new world. The central70% must be nearly empty softly lit warm plaster with very low contrast and faint texture, no foliage shadows or strong edges. At the far right outer edge show only a narrow slice of the original walnut window frame and a subtle glimpse of its courtyard. At the far bottom edge a slender hint of original wood skirting is acceptable. No desk, stool, plant or lamp in the central area. Keep all decorative interest confined to outer15% edges; centre must support readable real HTML controls. Target2400x1600 if supported; no invented text, labels, widgets, icons, symbols, people, logos or devices. Refined original architectural illustration, understated and tactile.
